senses.gloss: --came out when ब्रह्मा was in contemplation. वा. २१. ५४.

--of ललिता; by its side was one built by the architects to मन्त्रिनी when she visited ललिता; here the मातङ्गकन्यकास् sport and dance.
1: Br. IV. ३१. ८६.
The abode of Cakra- राज and lying at a distance of seven yojanas to शृङ्गारशाल; surmounted by gopuras in hundreds on all sides.
2: Ib. ३५. ७०, १०४.
On its different sides were Cidvanhi, चक्रराजरथ, Geyacakra, Kiricakra, Hari, गणपति, शिव, सरस्वती, महादेविस्, the residences of मन्त्रिनाथ and दण्डनाथ. In its midst was Binducakra with a number of शक्तिस्. There was also what is known as सर्वज्ञ yantara1. This चिन्तामणिगृह was located in the middle of श्रिपट्टण. Its walls and pillars, all of चिन्तामणि.
3: Ib. ३६. 1, ३३.
the kingdom watered by the R. चक्षु Br. II. १८. ४६; वा. ४७. ४४.
--the silk of the Shin country. M. १५४. २७६.
